content.title: Make the message matter.
content.hint: Specific details make a difference: what you offer, why it matters, and what to do next.

design.title: Give it a visual direction.
design.hint: Choose a Pro Editor style. AI will compose the modules and adapt the tone to your campaign.

signature.title: A signature that knows you.
signature.hint: Reuse the identity from a previous campaign or adjust your details before generating.

review.title: Ready to design.
review.hint: Review your choices. We will create a proposal using the editor’s actual modules.

proposal.title: Your campaign starts here.
proposal.hint: Review the email, try both sizes, and request any changes you need.

campaign_assistant.campaign_placeholder: E.g. Introduce our new autumn collection to customers who already know the brand.
campaign_assistant.objective_placeholder: E.g. Get bookings for an initial consultation
campaign_assistant.audience_placeholder: E.g. Small business marketing managers who want to save time and have already downloaded our guide.
campaign_assistant.offer_placeholder: Include actual benefits, products, prices, dates, and terms. You can paste a summary of your offer or event here.

campaign_assistant.creative_direction_placeholder: E.g. An airy editorial layout, strong headlines, and two highlighted benefits. You can include URLs for your own images.
